final-form.reason: The 1200 checkpoint gives clear armor, luminous headpieces and energy on both development cases at alpha 12; the 1600 checkpoint fragments at that alpha. Alpha 6 is too weak on the bare male case.
final-form.lora_reason: Alpha 24 is the closest whole-denoiser match among tested gains (edit RMS ratio 0.967, cosine 0.731) and restores the large transformation in both cases; alpha 36 diffuses structure into colored glow.

afterimage.reason: Alpha 8 provides repeated figures and translucent echoes in both cases. Alphas 10/12/16 turn the female case into a tiled collage; retain 8 as the calibrated nominal-one default.
afterimage.lora_reason: Alpha 16 restores repeated figures on both examples and is the lowest full-edit MSE in the sweep (0.315, cosine 0.829). Alpha 24 produces tiled faces and excessive overlap.

dusk.reason: Alpha 32 gives a visible warm twilight shift on both cases; lower alphas remain mild. Some framing and coat details change. This remains the completed 200-update pilot.
dusk.lora_reason: Alpha 96 reproduces the stronger twilight coloration at nearly equal full-edit RMS (0.998), cosine 0.917 and MSE 0.166. Lower gains remain visibly milder in both cases.
